fields.acceptance: cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/run-gate.txtar (or a new owner-run-gate-accept.txtar) shows a non-autonomous plan run's gate with accept auto and a passed review accepting each proposed change set under rule autonomy and journalling an accepted entry each; with accept owner, and with accept auto but a confirmed finding left without a question, the same gate leaves them proposed with the owner accept next; autonomous-run gate behaviour is unchanged; go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... passes
fields.statement: An owner-run (non-autonomous) plan run's gate, after proposing its plan's drafts, accepts each proposed change set under rule autonomy when rhiza.autonomy.accept is auto and the plan's review has passed by gateReview's check; when accept is owner or the review has not passed, it accepts nothing and leaves each proposal with rhiza accept --rule owner as its next step; the rhiza.autonomy.accept setting's description says it governs every plan run's gate

fields.acceptance: A testscript (extend autonomous-gate-rule.txtar or add autonomy-accept-rule.txtar) shows rhiza accept --rule autonomy refused as usage while rhiza.autonomy.accept is owner and accepted (the log entry records rule autonomy) while it is auto; rule autonomous outside an autonomous run is still refused as before
fields.statement: rhiza accept and reject take rule autonomy, recording that the owner's standing rhiza.autonomy.accept setting made the move; it is refused as usage unless rhiza.autonomy.accept is auto, and rule autonomous keeps meaning a move an unfinished autonomous run made

fields.acceptance: A testscript (extend inbox-list.txtar or add inbox-owner-run-accept.txtar) gates a non-autonomous plan run with rhiza.autonomy.accept owner and shows rhiza inbox listing each proposed change set as an accept item with next rhiza accept --rule owner --change <id>; once accepted, the item is gone; existing autonomous accept items still list
fields.statement: rhiza inbox lists each change set any plan run's gate proposed that is still proposed as an accept item waiting for acceptance, owner-run plan runs as well as autonomous ones, so a planned milestone never stalls unseen
